# Security Policy

## Reporting Vulnerabilities
`traces-sm` handles high-assurance cryptographic keys and sensitive secrets inside Intel SGX enclaves. If you discover a potential security vulnerability, enclave side-channel flaw, or cryptographic weakness, please do **NOT** create a public issue.

### Disclosure Channels
- 📧 **Private Advisory**: Open a [GitHub Security Advisory](https://github.com/ttraces-io/secrets-manager/security/advisories/new).
- 💬 **Discord**: Reach out to the core maintainers privately on [Discord](https://discord.gg/traces).
- ✉️ **Security Team Email**: `security@ttraces.io` / `security@traces.internal`.

All reports will be acknowledged within 24 hours. We appreciate your responsible disclosure!
